label: HMRC small business rates relief guidance
qualification: Relief depends on rateable value and occupier eligibility. No selected-unit rates bill or relief award has been verified.

label: HMRC employer rates 2026–27
qualification: Adult minimum wage £12.71/hour; employer NI and pension/holiday coverage must be budgeted. The report is not a payroll calculation.

label: HMRC catering VAT guidance
qualification: Hot drinks are standard-rated. The model assumes registered sales with a fully standard-rated mix and net recoverable costs; actual sales mix and recovery can differ.

label: ACCA cost-volume-profit method
qualification: Contribution method; constant basket, mix and cost assumptions over the modelled operating range. Not a sales prediction.

label: Sage coffee-shop costing guidance
qualification: Drinks and food have different margins. Scenario margins are planning assumptions, not surveyed local performance.
